stories.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
stories.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

stories.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
stories.summary: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.

stories.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats
stories.summary: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings.
